statement: ∀ (C K : ℕ) (M s t : ℕ → ℝ) (y B : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (U : ℝ), (∀ c ∈ Finset.range C, 0 ≤ M c) → (∀ c ∈ Finset.range C, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, y k * A k c) - s c ≤ t c) → (∀ k ∈ Finset.range K, B k ≤ y k * ∑ c ∈ Finset.range C, M c * A k c) → (∑ c ∈ Finset.range C, M c * s c ≤ U) → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, B k - U ≤ ∑ c ∈ Finset.range C, M c * t c

plain_statement.zh: 有限胞腔线性规划对偶见证与切换松弛下界
plain_statement.en: Finite cell linear-programming dual certificate with switched slack bound

brief.zh: 以非负胞腔质量乘逐胞腔对偶不等式后求和，交换有限双重和并代入各观测量下界与总切换松弛上界。
brief.en: Multiply the pointwise dual inequality by nonnegative cell masses, interchange the finite double sum, and substitute the observable lower bounds and total slack upper bound.
